{
  "name": "schedule_joint_meeting",
  "request_shape": "Find a free one-hour slot next week that works for both Dana Reyes and Sam Okafor, and propose it to them.",
  "inputs": [],
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "get_dana_availability",
      "kind": "lookup_via_agent",
      "inputs": [],
      "output": "dana_slots",
      "agent": "calendar",
      "find": "Dana Reyes free slots next week"
    },
    {
      "id": "get_sam_availability",
      "kind": "lookup_via_agent",
      "inputs": [],
      "output": "sam_slots",
      "agent": "calendar",
      "find": "Sam Okafor free slots next week"
    },
    {
      "id": "find_common_slots",
      "kind": "check_coverage",
      "inputs": ["dana_slots", "sam_slots"],
      "output": "common_slots",
      "rule": "intersection of dana_slots and sam_slots"
    },
    {
      "id": "select_slot",
      "kind": "check_coverage",
      "inputs": ["common_slots"],
      "output": "selected_slot",
      "rule": "select first slot with duration >= 60 minutes"
    },
    {
      "id": "draft_proposal",
      "kind": "write",
      "inputs": ["selected_slot"],
      "output": "proposal_text",
      "instruction": "Draft a polite message proposing the selected time slot to Dana Reyes and Sam Okafor.",
      "max_words": 50
    },
    {
      "id": "send_proposal",
      "kind": "lookup_via_agent",
      "inputs": ["proposal_text"],
      "output": "sent_status",
      "agent": "mail",
      "find": "Send proposal_text to Dana Reyes and Sam Okafor"
    }
  ],
  "output": "sent_status"
}

{
  "name": "find_shared_free_slot",
  "request_shape": "Find a free one-hour slot next week that works for both Dana Reyes and Sam Okafor, and propose it to them.",
  "inputs": [],
  "steps": [
    {
      "id": "get_dana_calendar",
      "kind": "lookup_via_agent",
      "inputs": [],
      "output": "dana_events",
      "agent": "calendar",
      "find": "events for Dana Reyes next week"
    },
    {
      "id": "get_sam_calendar",
      "kind": "lookup_via_agent",
      "inputs": [],
      "output": "sam_events",
      "agent": "calendar",
      "find": "events for Sam Okafor next week"
    },
    {
      "id": "generate_candidate_slots",
      "kind": "list",
      "inputs": [],
      "output": "candidate_slots",
      "source": "calendar",
      "filter": "one-hour slots next week 9am-5pm"
    },
    {
      "id": "check_dana_free",
      "kind": "classify",
      "inputs": ["dana_events", "candidate_slots"],
      "output": "dana_free_slots",
      "question": "Is this slot free for Dana Reyes?",
      "enum": ["free", "busy"]
    },
    {
      "id": "check_sam_free",
      "kind": "classify",
      "inputs": ["sam_events", "candidate_slots"],
      "output": "sam_free_slots",
      "question": "Is this slot free for Sam Okafor?",
      "enum": ["free", "busy"]
    },
    {
      "id": "filter_shared_free",
      "kind": "loop_over_items",
      "inputs": ["dana_free_slots", "sam_free_slots"],
      "output": "shared_free_slots",
      "over": "candidate_slots",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "is_shared_free",
          "kind": "check_coverage",
          "inputs": ["dana_free_slots", "sam_free_slots"],
          "output": "is_shared",
          "rule": "slot must be marked 'free' in both dana_free_slots and sam_free_slots"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "select_first_slot",
      "kind": "list",
      "inputs": ["shared_free_slots"],
      "output": "selected_slot",
      "source": "shared_free_slots",
      "filter": "first item"
    },
    {
      "id": "draft_proposal",
      "kind": "write",
      "inputs": ["selected_slot"],
      "output": "proposal_text",
      "instruction": "Draft a polite message proposing the selected time slot to Dana Reyes and Sam Okafor.",
      "max_words": 50
    },
    {
      "id": "verify_slot_exists",
      "kind": "check_coverage",
      "inputs": ["selected_slot", "candidate_slots"],
      "output": "verification_result",
      "rule": "selected_slot must exist in candidate_slots"
    }
  ],
  "output": "proposal_text"
}
